newsitem.title: USA: REV Holdings extends tender offer for notes.
newsitem.headline: REV Holdings extends tender offer for notes.

text.p: REV Holdings Inc, formerly the Revlon Worldwide Corp, said Tuesday that it has extended its offer to the holders of $770 million of its senior secured discount notes, due 2001 to exchange them for its series B senior secured discount notes due 2001, until 1700 EDT/2100 GMT, August 13.
The company said that as of August 11, $763.2 million, or 99.1 percent of the notes have been tendered.
REV is a holding company whose only significant asset is 83.1 percent of the common stock of Revlon Inc.
